note: Bounded native non-Git adapter. A Subversion revision is a repository-global counter that may touch paths in several projects and is never converted to a Git hash or treated as one project change; the author string is raw evidence, not an account; path actions are counts, not semantics. --repo invokes svn log --xml -v and retains source/stderr evidence; the local gate uses a controlled command shim because svn is not installed there.
